lcs :: String -> String -> Int
lcs [] _ = 0
lcs _ [] = 0
lcs s1 s2 = last (last dp)
  where
    m = length s1
    n = length s2
    dp = [[if i == 0 || j == 0 
           then 0 
           else if s1 !! (i-1) == s2 !! (j-1) 
                then dp !! (i-1) !! (j-1) + 1 
                else max (dp !! (i-1) !! j) (dp !! i !! (j-1))
           | j <- [0..n]] 
          | i <- [0..m]]
